statement: Counterexamples to Zariski’s multiplicity conjecture. Disproves Zariski's multiplicity conjecture by constructing reduced holomorphic hypersurface germs that are ambiently homeomorphic but have different multiplicities. The examples include hypersurfaces in ℂ<sup>4</sup> with isolated critical points and multiplicities four and five.
